title: models/pricing.py — SQLAlchemy ORM for 4 V2 pricing tables
scope: Four SQLAlchemy 2.x models all inheriting Base + TimestampMixin. PriceMasterModel (__tablename__='tbl_price_master'): id PK, design_id FK tbl_trading_design_master.id, grade_id FK tbl_grade_master.id, unit_price Numeric(10,2) CHECK>=0, effective_from Date, is_active Boolean DEFAULT True; UniqueConstraint(design_id, grade_id, effective_from, name='uq_price_design_grade_effective'); relationships design (TradingDesignModel lazy='joined'), grade (GradeModel lazy='joined'). InvoiceHeaderModel (__tablename__='tbl_invoice_header'): id PK, invoice_number String(30) UNIQUE, sales_header_id FK+UNIQUE tbl_sales_header.id, invoice_date Date, total_amount Numeric(12,2), status String(10) DEFAULT 'PENDING'; relationship lines (list[InvoiceLineModel] backref), payments (list[PaymentModel] backref), sales_header. InvoiceLineModel (__tablename__='tbl_invoice_line'): id PK, invoice_header_id FK, sales_line_id FK+UNIQUE, design_id Int, grade_id Int, quantity Int, unit_price Numeric(10,2), line_total Numeric(12,2). PaymentModel (__tablename__='tbl_payment'): id PK, invoice_header_id FK, payment_date Date, amount Numeric(12,2) CHECK>0, notes Text nullable.
